name: obs-dashboard
description: Read-only dashboard for the AI Observability & Guardrails Platform
//dependencies: Deliberately minimal. Every chart in this dashboard is hand-written SVG.
A charting library would add ~200 KB to the bundle and a dozen transitive
packages to `npm audit` for three charts, none of which need interaction
beyond a tooltip. Tailwind v4 needs no config file and no PostCSS plugins

the patched transitives is the smaller, reversible change and closes the
same advisories. Revisit when Next ships releases carrying these itself.
